title: Colour script → mood board (AI plate beside authored swatches)
description: The pair ADR 0094's `assisted` state exists for. One member declares `generated` (the Stable Diffusion colour script) and the other declares `assisted` (the mood board built over it), so this post mixes two DIFFERENT declared states — the only live post in the corpus that does, and the case a single-state post cannot exercise. It is labelled and it is NOT ai_pure, because ai_pure requires every member to be `generated`.

title: Studio colour chart — declared no generative AI
description: The calibration plate, on its own. It carries the corpus's only live `none` declaration: a positive statement by its maker that no generative model was involved. ⛔ `none` must never be rendered as a "no AI" badge or turned into a filterable claim about other people's work — it is the state a wrong rendering damages most, and until now no one could see it.
